title: Lane profile
description: A lane's declared identity and the fleet-policy hooks it runs at each hook point. Loaded and enforced by scripts/lane_hooks.py (#3933 S2).

id.description: Unique within its hook point; used in logs and error messages.

callable.description: 'module:function' resolved with importlib. The function receives one dict argument (the hook context) and returns nothing; raising fails the hook.

blocking.description: If true (the default), a failing hook raises HookBlockedError and stops the triggering action. If false, the failure is only recorded in the run() results.
